Name: Elhanan, Son of Jaare-oregim
Summary: Elhanan, son of Jaare-oregim of Bethlehem, struck down a Philistine giant in the battle at Gob. The Samuel text names his victim as Goliath the Gittite.
KeyStory: Elhanan of Bethlehem struck down a giant at Gob in David's later wars.
LifeLesson: Bethlehem, David's town, produced more than one giant-killer.
